SITE INFORMATION

Privacy Policy

Effective September 30, 2026

This policy explains how the Typhoon Labs website at typhoonlabs.dev handles information. It covers this website only. Our games and apps, and the stores that distribute them, may have separate privacy notices.

Information you provide

This site has no account, payment, or contact form. If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you include in your message. We use it to read and respond to your request. Email is handled by our email provider.

Technical information

Our hosting provider may process technical request data, such as IP address, browser information, pages requested, and timestamps, to deliver and protect the site. We do not currently use a separate analytics or advertising tracker on this website, and the site does not set its own tracking cookies.

Fonts and external links

The site loads fonts from Google Fonts. Your browser contacts Google to request those files, which may disclose technical connection information to Google. Links to the App Store and Google Play take you to independent services with their own privacy practices.

Retention and requests

Website request data is handled under the hosting provider’s retention practices. Email correspondence may be kept as needed to answer and follow up on your message. You can ask us about information you sent or request its deletion by emailing typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com.

Changes

We may update this policy when the site or its data practices change. The effective date above will change with it.

Contact

Questions about this website’s privacy practices: typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com.
